messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> p99 latency SLO burn (service: inference-api, region: us-west). Alert: p99 > 2.5s for 5m. page_id: PD-48392

tao: acked PD-48392 :hand: I'm oncall.

ashley: i'm checking hotpaths, looks like batch queue depth spiked around 13:02 UTC. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/dashboard/latency (sharing short link)

marta: interesting — token length distribution shows a surge of long-context requests (>=1024). KV cache miss rate also up ~18%.

tao: can we reroute noncritical traffic to cheaper variant? Jamie, any quick feature flags?

jamie: yes, rolling a quick route override now to model-variant v2-quick (lower mem, shorter max tokens). Doing feature-flag toggle via /api/route/switch -> curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"v2-quick","duration_s":300}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer 🤫'
```

ashley: scaling up dedicated pool in parallel — kubectl scale deployment inference-pool-uswest --replicas=6 (was 4). watching GPU queue.

marta: warming KV cache by replaying top-100 prefixes to the pool, should reduce cold misses. kicked off warmup job.

tao: observed p99 improve from 3.1s -> 2.6s after route override and first scale step. still above SLO but trending down.

incidents-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-48392 acknowledged by tao at 13:04 UTC. Autopager suppression disabled for this alert group.

ashley: added a temporary request size cap at the edge: 1200 tokens. config snippet:
```
edge-config:
  request_max_tokens: 1200
  reject_on_overlimit: true
```

jamie: posting customer impact: A small percentage (~2-3%) of requests in us-west may have seen degraded latency between 13:00-13:06 UTC. No errors returned, just slower responses.

tao: I'll keep this as high-priority until p99 < 2.0s for two consecutive 5m windows. If it creeps back, escalate to infra pager.

marta: warmup job finished, KV miss down to 4%. reverting route override in 2m if stable.

ashley: GPUs look healthy, QPS normalized. p99 now 1.9s.

tao: confirmed p99 1.9s and falling. marking incident as under control. leaving PD-48392 open for final postmortem. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PD-48392 status: acknowledged -> resolved (managed by tao). Note: auto-escalation suppressed after ack.

jamie: noted for incident timeline. will add brief summary to the ops channel and start a short RCA with steps: traffic reroute, scale up, KV warmup, edge cap.

tao: thanks team. follow-up action: add automated warmup for sudden long-context spikes and an alert on KV miss rate crossing 10% under high token-length QPS.

ashley: filing a small task in backlog for warmup automation and a playbook snippet. :spiral_notepad:
